notes: bytes = length of the packed state (to_bytes), names stored (u8 len + bytes); bytes_hashed_names uses 4-byte hashes (not reloadable; collision risk).
in-memory arithmetic is on the quantised grid; the in-memory vectors are not compact, the serialised state is (round-trip tested).
the f64 packed reference uses the same container format with 8-byte cells (dense or sparse per row).

protocol.big_world: my construction: 32 agents, 48 types x 4 keywords + 40 noise keywords, Zipf type popularity, 35% trap keyword map, drift on ~25% of types, 4000 tasks
protocol.decision_loss_same_history: teacher-forced: reference drives, twin is asked with the same random stream; mean over tasks of p(twin choice)-p(ref choice); low-variance one-step-ahead bound (no compounding)
protocol.equivalence: TOST per cell on mean expected success over the run, Holm over all cells of a split; lossless_claim = Holm p<0.05 AND 95% CI inside +-margin
protocol.power_extension: 91-250 frozen (added because 30 seeds cannot resolve a 0.003 margin in noisy worlds)
protocol.reference: same Warm(k=1, MeanFeature) with f64 state (MiniHeb f64 verified decision-identical to HebbianRouter)
protocol.tune: 1-8 (adaptive-precision rule only; row budgets are fractions of the f64 row count on tune seeds)
